Polygon.description_en:
The polygon formed by a number of points. This parameter takes effect only when the boundary describes a polygon rather than a rectangle.

This parameter is mutually exclusive to the following parameters that form a rectangle: Width, Height, Left, and Top. A boundary describes only a rectangle or a polygon
Polygon.description_zh:
使用若干个点围成的闭合多边形范围，当Boundary描述的是多边形框而非矩形框时有效。

<notice>该字段与Width / Height / Left / Top 四个参数组成的矩形范围参数只会出现一种。即当前 Boundary 描述只可能是一个矩形框或多边形框的一种，具体种类和当前框内容的形态本身一致。></notice>

description_en: Detects the outline data, attributes, and license plate information of vehicles in an image. The vehicle attributes include the vehicle color (CarColor) and vehicle type (CarType). The license plate information includes the recognition content (Content) and plate frame (Boundary)
description_zh: 检测指定图像中的车辆边界信息、车辆属性信息、车牌信息。车辆属性信息包括：车辆颜色（CarColor）、车辆类型（CarType）；车牌信息包括：车牌识别内容（Content）、车牌框信息（Boundary）
kebab_example: aliyun imm detect-image-cars --project-name test-project --source-uri oss://test-bucket/test-object.jpg --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetectImageCars

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The URI of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket in which you store the image file.

Specify the value in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project. `${Object}` specifies the complete path to the file that has an extension
parameters.help_zh:
文件的OSS存储地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
